description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Player icon style:** the speed, mute and download buttons of the `Overlay buttons` patch now follow the style too (Fluent, Phosphor, Phosphor Light, Phosphor Fill, Phosphor Duotone, Ionicons, Sharp and Custom). Automatic, Thin and Bold keep the icons of the patch's `Icon type` option.
- **Player icon style:** the miniplayer's play, pause, replay and close buttons now follow the style. Automatic, Thin and Bold keep the original miniplayer icons.

## Bug Fixes
- **YouTube - Player buttons:** `Hide player control buttons background` now also removes the circle behind the fullscreen button.
- **YouTube - Shorts icon style:** the `Shorts icon style` now also works on devices that install YouTube from split APKs, where the Shorts action buttons kept their original icons.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.16.0...v1.16.1)
